title: WAIT
tagline: Wait for the mercy of the Lord.
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: Keep yourselves in God's love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.

session.prompt: Wait in the quiet and listen — keep yourself in God's love and ask Him to steady your hope as you wait for His mercy.

coaching_notes: Think of today's session as fuel for endurance. Listening for God is a long workout. Don't miss the value of simply listening.
